items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 29 at 1:18AM PDT until September 29 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 7 to 10 ft at 14 seconds and southwest winds 15 to
25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
